optimizedContext.value:
# ListGuidesQuery

Lists guide catalog summaries for `specd guide` / MCP directory tools.

## Rules

### GuideCatalogPort (driven port)
- `listGuides(): Promise<readonly GuideSummary[]>` — all guide summaries
- `getGuide(topic: string): Promise<GuideTopic | null>` — by topic ID, else `null`
- `getAllGuides(): Promise<readonly GuideTopic[]>` — full entities (exists in code; spec omits it)

### ListGuidesQuery
- Ctor injects `GuideCatalogPort`
- `execute(): Promise<readonly GuideSummary[]>` reads `catalogPort.listGuides()`
- MUST copy before sort (`[...rawGuides]`) — never mutate catalog storage
- Sort ascending numeric `order`; tie-break `a.topic.localeCompare(b.topic)` (locale-aware, NOT code-unit order)
- `GuideSummary` = `topic`, `title`, `description`, `order`, `lineCount`, `byteLength`

## Constraints
- Pure application query; zero infra/framework deps
- `order` (= frontmatter `sidebar_position`) NOT unique in existing catalog: 0..12, duplicates at 1, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 — topic tie-break is load-bearing, not theoretical
- Second (SDK) catalog reuses same port+query: `order` collides ACROSS catalogs, so a merged listing interleaves SDK and existing guides alphabetically unless `order` is namespaced per collection
- `PrebundledGuideCatalogAdapter` supplies catalog + `GUIDES_INDEX`; `getGuide` normalizes topic (trim, lowercase, strip `.md`)
